qwrun vs MLX vs llama.cpp — 2026-10-20
**qwrun writes 19–35% faster than the installed llama.cpp on these three deployed 4-bit variants, but remains 2–5% behind stock MLX.**
Prompt reading is faster than llama.cpp and modestly faster than MLX, with a clear 25% lead over MLX on Qwen3-0.6B. Single-session model resources are broadly similar to MLX; the much smaller process footprint is not a measure of total RAM.
